# Motion

Motion is an intelligent calendar and project management tool that automatically plans your day, schedules meetings, and helps teams collaborate efficiently.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/motion/.

## Actions

- **Create Task**: Create a new task in Motion.
- **Delete Custom Field**: Delete a custom field from Motion workspace.
- **Delete Custom Field From Project**: Delete a custom field value from a project in Motion.
- **Delete Recurring Task**: Delete a recurring task from Motion based on the ID supplied.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a task from Motion based on task ID.
- **Get My User Information** (read-only): Get information on the owner of the API key.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve a single project by its ID.
- **Get Task by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a task by its ID from Motion.
- **List Custom Fields** (read-only): Retrieve all custom fields for a given Motion workspace.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Get all projects for a workspace.
- **List Recurring Tasks** (read-only): Get all recurring tasks for a workspace.
- **List Schedules** (read-only): Get a list of schedules for your user.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): Get all tasks for a given query with optional filtering.
- **Unassign Task**: Unassign a task from its current assignee.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task in Motion.
- **Add Custom Field to Project**: Add a custom field value to a project in Motion.
- **Add Custom Field to Task**: Add a custom field value to a task in Motion.
- **Create Comment**: Create a new comment on a Motion task.
- **Create Custom Field**: Create a new custom field in a Motion workspace.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in Motion.
- **Create Recurring Task**: Create a new recurring task in Motion.
- **Delete Custom Field From Task**: Delete a custom field value from a task in Motion.
- **List comments on task** (read-only): Get all comments on a specific task.
- **List Statuses** (read-only): Get a list of statuses for a Motion workspace.
- **List users** (read-only): Get a list of users for a given workspace or team.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): Retrieve all workspaces a user has access to.
- **Move Task to Workspace**: Move a task to a different workspace in Motion.
